_doc: Box cases for the MCM-subset vs SANDBOX comparison. Mixing ratios in ppb; H2O for trop is set from RH with the Buck formula of tomas_jax.gaschem.environment. Both models start from the same species; species one model lacks start at zero in the other. 'mcm_background' is added only in the MCM 'background' variant (SANDBOX has no CO or H2). hold_NOx_ppb: NO and NO2 rescaled after every 300 s so NO + NO2 stays at this value (null = NOx free). Without it the troposphere case loses 90 % of its NOx to HNO3 by noon (OH about 2e7 cm-3 with no VOC), so the 1 ppb NOx condition would hold only at sunrise.

trop.label: (a) troposphere: 298.15 K, 1013.25 hPa, RH 50 %, 40 N, 1 July

strat.label: (b) lower stratosphere, SAI-like: 220 K, 50 hPa, 4 ppm H2O, 30 N, 21 June, 10 ppb SO2
